name: Klarna API
tagline: Buy now, pay later payments and checkout for e-commerce
description: Klarna provides payment and checkout APIs for online merchants: Hosted Checkout, Payments (KP), Order Management, Settlements, and related services so shoppers can pay later or in installments at checkout.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth with API username and password (merchant credentials) from the Klarna Merchant Portal; playground and production have separate credentials.

pricing.paid_plans: Merchant fees and pricing negotiated via Klarna merchant agreement; API access is not a separate public SaaS subscription.

use_cases: create a Klarna payment session for checkout
render Klarna widget with client token
place and capture a Klarna order
